svg.text: GHOSTED: Gary the pigeon postman, explore (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Illustrator Phase 1-2: local references, 10 rough thumbnails, 3 directions, one pick. Designed curves lifted to round bodies (Ricky / Juno sketch library); palette rows only.
REFERENCES (local only, the locked family; no web)
Kit v5
Ricky v1
Ghostie v7
ATS-9000 v1
Auntie Dot v1
Brett v1
Juno v1
Panel v1
Panel v1 lineup at the game camera (x1.5): the family on grass, Kit centre
THUMBNAILS (10). Top: front, rough. Below: the same at the game camera (x3, 26 m, pitch 42, net yaw 5), 0.5 x Kit, with Kit.
1 egg, kepi, front bag
2 BMGD literal: sphere, box wings
3 sphere, kepi, front bag
4 upright pear, wide cap, side bag
5 small head, grey wings, ink cap
6 big head (toy), kepi
7 wide cap ink, light bag
8 no cap: bag + letter only
9 visor only, grey wings
10 sphere, box wings + post kit
DIRECTIONS (3), developed: front, 3/4, side; then the game camera (x3) next to Kit (real render)
A. ROUND POSTIE (pick)
A tilted egg body (chest up, tail down), a round
toy head, a gold beak, navy kepi set back on the
crown, a wood satchel on the belly. Darker blue
wings and tail carry the value on grass and path;
the cap and bag say 'post'. The wing tip has 3
finger feathers, so it can hold a letter like a hand.
B. PIGEON-TRUE
Small grey head, grey wings, ink cap, a light
panel-edge bag. More real pigeon, but grey 18 is
the ATS robot row, the small head loses the eyes
at the game camera, and the light bag sinks into
the path.
C. BMGD LITERAL + POST
A sphere with a cone beak and 2 box wings, plus
the kepi and bag. Cheap to build, but the box
wings read as a backpack or arms, not wings, and
a ball with no tail is a chick, not a pigeon.
PICK: A. It is the only one that reads 'bird plus post' at 37 px: the gold beak points down-forward under two clear eyes, the navy cap is a dark top no one else has, the blue wings
and tail give the dark value that light blue-grey 8 lacks on grass (1.1:1), and the satchel + strap is the postman read. Round, soft and a little clumsy: the kindest courier.
